title: NOX local micro-receipt
description: Signed local receipt issued by capsule_payment and accepted by publishers. Settled in batches against ReceiptSettlement (mainnet 0x1b522b9d62986f4ad0e7e881bad464b6e7e37317) which routes NOX through FeeRouter (0x0d0dd1d8d2940ed4c1cf05635722528def612559). The signature is EIP-712 typed data over the on-chain Receipt struct, recovered with ECDSA.recover(_hashTypedDataV4(structHash), signature) and required to equal `user`. Field names, order, and types match IReceiptSettlement.Receipt one-to-one.

x-eip712.typeString: Receipt(bytes32 capsuleId,address user,address publisher,uint256 amountNox,uint256 nonce,uint256 epoch,uint256 expiry,bytes32 receiptType)
x-eip712.structHash: keccak256(abi.encode(typeHash, capsuleId, user, publisher, amountNox, nonce, epoch, expiry, receiptType)) — nine 32-byte words, addresses left-padded to 32 bytes, uint256 big-endian.
x-eip712.digest: keccak256(0x1901 || domainSeparator || structHash); domainSeparator = keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256('EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)'), keccak256(domain.name), keccak256(domain.version), chainId, verifyingContract)).
x-eip712.signature: secp256k1 recoverable signature over digest. 65 bytes = r(32) || s(32) || v(1), v in {27,28}.

schema_version.description: Receipt envelope version. Bumped to 2 when the receipt switched from EIP-191/BLAKE3 to EIP-712/keccak256 to match the deployed verifier.

chain_id.description: EIP-712 domain chainId. Mainnet. A receipt carrying any other chain_id is rejected before signing; settlement on a fork/wrong chain recovers a different signer and fails wrong-signer.

verifying_contract.description: EIP-712 domain verifyingContract: the live ReceiptSettlement proxy. Part of the domain separator, so a receipt signed for any other contract fails recovery.

domain_name.description: EIP-712 domain name, exactly as set by __EIP712_init on-chain.

domain_version.description: EIP-712 domain version, exactly as set by __EIP712_init on-chain.

capsuleId.description: bytes32 capsule id, the BLAKE3-derived capsule_id from the manifest as a 0x-prefixed 32-byte value. capsuleRegistry.publisherOf(capsuleId) must equal `publisher` or settlement fails wrong-publisher.

user.description: Ethereum address of the wallet that signs the receipt and is debited NOX. Must equal ECDSA.recover(_hashTypedDataV4(structHash), signature). The wallet must hold an ERC-20 allowance to verifying_contract for at least amountNox before batchSettle.

publisher.description: Ethereum address of the publisher that redeems the receipt and receives the publisher split via FeeRouter.

amountNox.description: uint256 NOX amount in atto-NOX (18 decimals), as a decimal string to avoid float loss. Must be > 0 or settlement fails zero-amount.

nonce.description: Monotonic per (user, publisher), issued by capsule_payment. Part of the struct hash, so reusing a nonce with identical fields produces the same hash and fails replay.

epoch.description: Settlement epoch = (block.timestamp - epochZero) / epochDuration, epochDuration = 86400s. Settlement accepts epoch == currentEpoch or epoch + 1 == currentEpoch (one-epoch grace); anything else fails wrong-epoch.

expiry.description: ABSOLUTE unix timestamp in seconds at which the receipt becomes invalid, compared against block.timestamp on-chain. 0 means never expires. NOT a boot-relative clock.

receiptType.description: bytes32 tag describing the charge. Convention: keccak256 of a lowercase ASCII label. install = keccak256('install'), subscribe = keccak256('subscribe'), use = keccak256('use'). Included in the struct hash and emitted in ReceiptSettled; not otherwise validated on-chain.

structHash.description: keccak256(abi.encode(typeHash, capsuleId, user, publisher, amountNox, nonce, epoch, expiry, receiptType)). Equals ReceiptSettlement.hashReceipt(r). The signature is over _hashTypedDataV4(structHash), not over this value directly.

signature.description: 65-byte secp256k1 recoverable signature over the EIP-712 digest keccak256(0x1901 || domainSeparator || structHash). Layout r(32)||s(32)||v(1), v in {27,28}. EIP-712 typed data, NOT EIP-191 personal_sign.
